article.body:
90 minutes of unfiltered product advice from Snap and Discord’s product chief | Peter Sellis

Lenny’s Podcast’s Peter Sellis episode is a 97-minute interview about product management at Snapchat and Discord. It is available on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts; the accompanying Lenny’s Newsletter page is marked paid, with no other access restrictions specified. The newly published episode gives listeners Sellis’s perspectives on team design, exceptional talent, product growth, advertising and product management trade-offs. This is editorial content, not a new product capability: it extends Lenny Rachitsky’s existing podcast format, and the episode offers no independently verified evidence for Sellis’s claims or any product deployment.
